name: claude-code-logos
description: Plugins that manage how Claude Code runs — how skills are written, which model and effort to use, where documentation answers come from. Each states the evidence it rests on.

plugins.name: skill-best-practices
plugins.description: Evidence-based practices for writing better Claude Code skills — 8 practices from cognitive science with before/after examples, plus hooks that deliver the rules at runtime

plugins.name: model-effort
plugins.description: Choose the Claude model and effort level for each situation — session, subagents, Workflow agents, skill frontmatter, API scripts — with Claude Code and API defaults kept apart and every recommendation tagged with its source

plugins.name: livedocs
plugins.description: Answer questions about a library, SDK or CLI from its primary source, read live — llms.txt, package registry, repository, OpenAPI/GraphQL, CLI introspection — through an MCP server and a look-up skill. macOS only; the plugin downloads its MCP server binary
